coverage.reason: Add email/password signup, recovery, verification and same-UID Google linking. Shared client auth lifecycle, callable wrappers and Firestore guards affect login, session takeover, identity preservation and game authorization. Exercise actual methods with SDK fixtures, desktop/mobile form behavior, direct emulator permission enforcement, and the verified-auth fixture helper.

Package, fingerprint and cache the new email UI on web and iframe entries; bound its source increase to 32 KiB and independently cap its UI at 14 KiB. Build/artifact validation is also required by the runtime diff.

Record explicitly approved email-account behavior, coordinated release configuration and ordering, rollback constraints, measured artifact allowance and the Auth emulator same-email-linking limitation. Documentation requires no separate runtime execution.
